caption: Settings tab: filter PHP error types, choose the error display mode, and configure logging.
WP_DEBUG tab: toggle debug constants in wp-config.php without editing files.
Error Log tab: colour-coded debug.log with pagination, live polling, download, and clear.
Cron Tasks tab: overdue events, orphaned hooks, source detection, and one-click actions.
Transients tab: every database transient with size and expiry, plus bulk purge of expired rows.
Autoloaded tab: the heaviest autoloaded options, sorted by size, to spot request bloat.
HTTP Log tab: outgoing WordPress HTTP API calls with status, transport, and duration.
Constants tab: runtime WordPress constants grouped by category, with secrets masked.
